_about: Verdicts for the PR #34 code on heldout_v3 (12 held-out incidents + 5 rollback traps), written by reading every full-context diagnosis against the injected fault (cases_heldout.py) with the same rubric as hand_checks_heldout.json; traps use ml/data/llm_eval/trap_rubric.md (committed before any model run). Not produced by the regex matcher or by a model.
